. Sub: Payment to the Overseas Bank Accounts of International Workers & their beneficiaries belonging
to SSA countries-regarding.

Madam/Sir,

The procedure to facilitate payment to the overseas bank accounts of International Workers and their
beneficiaries was laid down vide the circular No. IWU/8(2)2009/Banking Agreement/19453 dated
20.10.2014.

2. Recently some references have been received from stakeholders stating the practical hardships faced
by IWs & their employers such as requirement to submit Form 15 CB (Tax Determination Certificate) and
filing of Form 15 CA by employers leading to potential issues related to income tax & auditing.

3. In order to remove such hardships by aligning the procedure for payment to the overseas bank accounts
of International Workers and their beneficiaries with extant rule position/ legislations, the following

_ simplified and consolidated procedure for enhanced Ease of Doing Business for employers & improved
Ease of Living for employees is laid down:

i. The facility of payment to overseas bank account of International workers is only for those
countries with which India has signed Social Security Agreement (SSA).

ii. The claim of International workers shall be settled in concerned Regional office. However, the
dealing assistants in the field offices, while settling International Worker’s claims will enter the
overseas bank account details in the database of claim settlement module of the application
software so that the funds can be transferred from their respective link branch to the bank

accounts mentioned in the Annexure-1.

iii.

vi.

vii.

viii.

Benefits payable to International Workers of SSA countries shall be paid at his/her choice of

country (i.e. in India or in their home country or third country), as per relevant provisions in the
bilateral SSA signed with respective country.

The Foreign bank account of the International Workers can be verified by copy of Bank Account
Passbook/ Bank Statement attested by the employer or the Competent Institution/Liaison Agency
under that bilateral SSA.

The concerned Regional Offices will complete the necessary documentation as per the format in
Annexure-2 for onward transmission to Regional Office, Delhi (North).

As per Section 195 of Income Tax Act, EPFO is the remitter and therefore having statutory
responsibility for filing of Form 15 CA & also for submission of Tax Determination Certificate (Form
15 CB). Regional Office, Delhi (North) will facilitate & act as the Nodal Office for filing of Form
15 CA and Form 15 CB. All the concerned ROs settling the claim of IWs will provide necessary
information to the RO, Delhi (North) for filling of above-mentioned Forms.

A dedicated Chartered Accountant for this work will be hired by RO, Delhi (North) following GFR -
provisions.

The respective RO’s settling the claim for IWs shall ensure that there is no error in the tax
deductions. Further for any procedural deficiencies in such tax deductions, the respective RO shall
be responsible for assisting RO, Delhi (North) for appropriate corrections through the Chartered
Accountant.

Separate control registers for such payments shall be maintained in the concerned ROs as well
as Regional Office, Delhi (North). The control registers maintained in the concerned ROs shall be
reconciled with the control register in RO, Delhi (North) on monthly basis.

4. In addition, the instructions issued earlier vide Circular No. |WU/7/(25)/2017/Payment of PF and
Withdrawal Benefits/34140 dated 23.03.2017 regarding payment of Provident Fund and withdrawal
benefit under Pension scheme on the date of leaving service to International Workers (IWs) are being
re-iterated.

5. All concerned may please ensure the strict compliance.

Encl: As above

(This issues with the approval of CPFC)

(Vipin Kumar Sharma) ©
Additional Central P.F. Commissioner (ICSSD)
